title: Rejection probability for the pair tester
statement: For every positive integer $n$ and every Boolean string $w$ of length $2n$, the rejection probability of the tester that samples a pair uniformly and checks whether its two values agree equals the fraction of pairs in which the values of $w$ differ.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string of length $2n$
